notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, DPS here! We're so happy that you're all enjoying the game so far. This is the first of probably many, but not *too* many bugfix patches. Here are the changes:

[b]Version 1.0.1[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased memory usage of the Atom Map (hopefully no more memory leak!)
[*] Rewrote hint text for secret levels to be a bit easier to figure out
[*] Fixed mismatched descriptions and visual errors in [spoiler]gone fishin'[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed unlock for the achievement [spoiler]Good job. Rodney is very proud of you.[/spoiler] triggering earlier than intended
[*] Added a description to the custom loop points option in the level editor
[/list]
More to come soon, and thank you for all the support!

notes.title: BEATBLOCK's Early Access is available now!
notes.content: [p]Thet wait is over! Play [i]"Beat the Rhythm and Notes - A Test of Wit & Flow, A series of Challenging Songs ~With the Intent of Being Enjoyed"[/i], otherwise known in the modern times as [i]"Beatblock"[/i], today![/p][previewyoutube="CuCUjDOTtQw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It'll be available with a limited-time launch discount at 10% off MSRP ($14.99 USD), with 27 songs in the launch roster (each with full, bespoke visuals), and a host of revamps and changes compared to what's been available in the demo. Please stay tuned for that, and for those hopping right into the world's first crank-action rhythm game, we can't thank you enough for supporting us![/p][p][/p][p]LAUNCH DAY FAQ & KNOWN ISSUES HERE:[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3045200/discussions/0/596286923596980618/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3045200/discussions/0/596286923596980618/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Happy Cranking![/p][p]-Jeff @ SKY HOUR WORKS[/p][p]( ^^ )=)[/p]

notes.title: 2025 Demo Update (0.6.0)
notes.content: [h1]We're in the final stretch before Early Access![/h1][h3]It's releasing this fall. Pinky promise.[/h3][p][i]ignore the fact that cranky has no fingers.[/i][/p][p]For those of you who've stuck around, just wait a bit longer! For those new to Beatblock, you're in for one heck of a time. Let's get into what's new. (Or just skip to the changelog at the bottom for the short version.)[/p][p][/p][h2]A new level about side notes.[/h2][p]Love them or hate them, they're the Most Note Of All Time. And they have a very storied history.[/p][p]Ranked #1 Note in [i]Beatblocker's Magazine[/i] two years running, with an origin that dates back to the late 19th century. Learn more and get a grip on sides in the new level [b]público cautivo[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069954/ae28ed840eeb8df9c738585f4473b58e305a62df.png"][/img][i]Comes with a guided audio tour of the Side Note Exhibit.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Importantly, this new level will be [u]replacing the level [b]Code Remix.[/b][/u] [/p][p]Don't worry- It'll still be playable in Early Access! But to keep the intended demo flow intact, we opted to swap out Code Remix for público cautivo. We hope you have fun with the new level![/p][p][/p][h2]A revamped tutorial.[/h2][p]Let's be fair: the original tutorial was kind of a Hot Mess. Who likes having every single note type thrown at you (except for the secret one) at once?? We fixed that. There's a new tutorial instead to acquaint you with the basics- and only the basics. Blocks, holds, and taps.[/p][p][/p][p]We also added helpful images before other relevant levels to [u]explain individual mechanics![/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069954/2b4ba9df961561e33668727d128be8971badfbad.gif"][/img][i]Please be kind to Cranky. There are many note types and some of them hurt.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]tha changer logge[/h2][h3][b]Version 0.6.0[/b] [/h3][list][*][p][b]Swapped out Code Remix for a new level, público cautivo![/b][/p][list][*][p]This was done to improve the flow of teaching the side note mechanic to new players. Code Remix will still be available to play in the full game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Reworked Tutorial to only include Blocks, Holds, and Taps.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added explanatory images to levels that introduce new mechanics[/b] (Gritted Strings, público cautivo, ILOVEYOU.vbs)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved High DPI display on Windows devices.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed error message when trying to load an early access level in the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a failsafe to saving that should help with crashes relating to low storage space.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]See you again when Early Access launches this fall! ( ^^ )=)[/h3]

notes.title: Summer 2025 Development Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hello! ( ^^ )=)[/h2][p]It's been a while. We hope you've been having fun![/p][p][/p][p]Our developers have been hard at work fleshing out the game. 
Here's a little preview of what we've been up to. [/p][p][/p][h3]Woe. GIFs upon ye[/h3][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069954/a3d8261c40938da088961a60a9909a5045855ade.gif"][/img]costumes![/p][/td][td][p]UI tweaks![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069954/6cb798d18f7cf1873e3854413afc82a83ff42cdb.gif"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]rich text functions![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069954/8ffca562ed348619bac492e487010dbcbcb0ea25.gif"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069954/bb85fe3f387efaca9f90f237ac351226c1a7c561.gif"][/img][/p][p]this guy killing it on the piano![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Community Events[/h3][p]Besides devwork, we've been hosting some intermittent charting jams on our [url="https://discord.gg/BWyPQd2w2b" buttoncolor="#0080c0"]Discord server[/url] with featured artists! Welcome to [b]BUILDING BLOCKS[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069954/942ee2468240318fadd3bd5b49b0a1d4d0f00470.png"][/img]The artists give you clips. You chart 'em. At the end of it all- share and swap your charts, and get a shiny role icon in the server for participating! If it sounds like your cup of tea, feel free to join in.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, keep an eye out once Early Access launches for [b]GET PRANKED[/b]: a cooperative high-score event where players band together to reach a shared goal. You may have seen the first round occur on our [url="https://x.com/BeatblockGame"]Twitter page[/url] with Camellia's [i]+ERABY+E CONNEC+10N[/i], and you can bet there'll be more in the future! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069954/abce1e5d44129f9cf799731b6c1f592716745ed8.png"][/img]This event will pull out [i]some of our most challenging songs[/i] to grind for P-ranks, so keep those spinning skills sharp![/p][p][/p][h3]"okay but when you droppin"[/h3][p]Fortunately, we have an answer! Expect Early Access to drop [i]this fall![/i][/p][p]We're looking forward to finally sharing what we've worked on- with that said, here's what you can expect.[/p][list][*][p]A completely new song unlock system, separate from the demo's songwheel.[/p][/*][*][p]New songs, bringing the level count to 27! Some may have incomplete visuals to be updated after their release.[/p][/*][*][p]A new block to beat?![/p][/*][*][p]Costumes to dress up your Cranky however you want.[/p][/*][*][p]Level editor improvements, with an overhauled UI option coming later.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfixes! And new bugs to fix, most likely.[/p][/*][*][p]Secrets.....[/p][/*][/list][p]While this won't put us at our full scope just yet, we're itching to get these new features into your hands as soon as possible. [/p][h3]Thank you all for playing Beatblock! See you soon in Early Access...[/h3]

notes.title: Final demo update + early access announcement!
notes.content:
Hiya! It's been awhile and we're back with our final update to the demo.

Before the new stuff...

[h2][b]EARLY ACCESS LAUNCH LATER THIS YEAR![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069954/7cae52f6a41edd0343e9163ff8c9801805c98c35.gif[/img]
We'll be locking in and focusing on getting Beatblock ready for an early access launch later in 2025! That means [i]no more plans to add new content to the demo[/i] (although with the editor, you may not have a problem with that.) With that being said, the EA release will include: 
[list]
[*]New songs (both licensed and original) 
[*]New features (different modes of play, different note types, etc.)
[*]New editor functions
[*]UI revamps
[*]canky bebloc
[/list]We hope you continue to enjoy the demo, and appreciate your patience as we continue development.

With that out of the way...

[h2]WHAT'S NEW IN THE DEMO?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Marathon Mode- test your endurance by playing through all the demo levels! All of them. Every single one. Marathon Mode is [u]unlocked by getting an A rank or higher on the default difficulty of every demo level[/u].
[*][i]Maybe there's a reward for doing well?...[/i]
[*]Lots of bugfixes, as detailed below.
[/list]
[h3]the bugfix heap[/h3]
[list]
[*]The editor now prevents the user from placing more than one "play song" and "show results" event per level. [b]If there are multiple play song events in an existing level, the level will need to be updated to only use one.[/b]
[*]Tweaked hitbox on Inverse notes slightly to better match their visual appearance
[*]Fixed events on or before beat 0 not initializing properly.
[*]Fixed retrying levels via the Results screen not applying level modifiers.
[*]Prevented event placement while holding down Alt in the editor.
[*]Fixed Mouse position being incorrect for non-standard display resolutions.
[*]Fixed hold start angle mismatch when starting between frames.
[*]Hold Leniency will now increase when playing back a level at less than 1x Speed.
[*]Added more help markers to level properties (ctrl+i) menu.
[*]Added a warning to the "Play Sound" event clarifying that it is not meant to be used for music playback.
[*]Fixed hidden child decos not reappearing in their correct positions when unhidden.
[*]Fixed a crash when hitting "Retry" after playing a level with game speed not set to 1.
[*]Fixed some events rendering as black squares when placed near certain notes with taps.
[*]Fixed flash easables bypassing eyestrain reduction and saturation accessibility options.
[/list]

notes.title: Next Fest approacheth...
notes.content:
Next Fest is upon us once again, and we arrive with gifts! 
And by gifts we mean a patch adding bugfixes, easy/hard variants for several demo levels, and some QoL changes.

Here's the rundown: 

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked the level format to allow for multiple difficulties stored in a single level
[*] Added an easier difficulty to ILOVEYOU.vbs and lawrence
[*] Added a harder difficulty to so stressed! 
[*] Added the ability to unpause
[*] Added "Toggle particles" event
[*] Added "Play sound" event
[*] Added cs.objectRotation easable
[*] Window positions are now saved between editor sessions. To reset your windows to default, press CTRL+R
[/list]
[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed expanded HUD accuracy display
[*] The editor no longer crashes when trying to load a level with a non-existent event
[*] Fixed system cursor not hiding when using a custom cursor
[*] System cursor now re-appears when the game is paused
[*] Fixed outline event not working correctly with a color index over 3
[*] Fixed abnormally long level loading times sometimes causing levels to break
[*] Alphabetized editor palette
[/list]

Additionally, we're currently working on getting our Mac and Linux compatibility visible again for our demo, so we appreciate your patience! We're still compatible with all three major OSes (Windows, Mac, Linux) and if you attempt to download the demo it'll give you the right version. 

[h3]Thank you very much for playing Beatblock! More news tomorrow... :0[/h3]
(if you're a musician or producer, get ready!)

notes.title: Rhythm Fest begins! (and a small patch, as a treat)
notes.content:
[h3]Rhythm Fest is upon us, and we have a small update as a gift![/h3]

We also have a wiki.gg page established- [url=https://beatblock.wiki.gg/wiki/Beatblock_Wiki]check it out here![/url] You can check out level info here, and we'll be keeping this updating in the future!

Thank you to all the new wishlisters and players supporting us- we'll have more for you soon (and maybe some more levels?)
For now, happy Beatblocking and keep groovin'!

[h1]Version 0.2.1[/h1]
[h2]Game:[/h2]
[list][*] Added a pause screen!
[list][*] It only has Reset and Quit options for now...[/list]
[*] [b]Added song options, including:[/b]
[list][*] Game speed
[*] Existing accessibility options for convenience
[*] Restart on miss/barely
[*] Count barelies as misses[/list]
[*] [b]Added drag and drop support for custom levels! Try dragging a zip file while the custom level screen is open.[/b]
[*] Added rebindable keys!
[*] Added new minehold particles! They look really cool!
[*] Tweaked ILOVEYOU.vbs slightly
[*] Side note SFX now always play, instead of being only on-hit, for parity with taps.
[*] Exiting out of a level now sends you back to where you were in the song select
[*] Expanded expanded UI to optionally show misses/barelies
[*] Added a toggle for menu music
[*] Fixed taps at hold end nodes causing misses when near other taps
[*] Fixed hold rendering glitching out with some eases
[*] Fixed a crash with blank song images
[*] Fixed levels and tags being meaninglessly "updated" for no reason.
[*] Fixed some blue screen errors on older devices relating to shader compilation
[*] Fixed 0 duration mineholds being pass-throughable (an exception is made for 0 duration mineholds that have the same start and end angle)
[/list]
 
 
[h2]Editor:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Expanded allowed colors to 8![/b]
[*] [b]Added custom player faces. put in the name of a .png file in the spriteName property![/b]
[*] Added autosave backups, in case of crashes
[*] Added vfx.ignoreNoiseCorrection boolean, for levels that use the HOM canvas in unconventional ways.
[*] Added `p.outlineColor`, `p.fillColor`, and `p.faceColor` easables.
[*] Fixed 0 segment holds crashing the editor (sorry.....)
[*] Fixed negative song offsets (by removing the ability to do it)
[*] Fixed mine preview ghost being that of a normal note
[*] Fixed a crash with trying to place a non-existent event
[/list]

Note: the new mine particle effects currently cause lag spikes for some lower-end devices, and we're currently working on a hotfix to remedy this. Thank you for your understanding!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45069954/a422cd4029f1e3a486de7dc5ddb0dc46ff1eee21.gif[/img]

notes.title: SECOND SUMMER UPDATE: ILOVEYOU.vbs
notes.content:
[h3]We hope you’ve been enjoying everything in Beatblock so far- here’s some more![/h3]

[h2][b]New level: ILOVEYOU.vbs[/b][/h2]
A tricky level showing off the inverse note mechanic, with the track “ILOVEYOU.vbs” from Aspid Cat! Be careful with your email, or you might open up a nasty surprise…
[previewyoutube=hqBLTw2SFoE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Accessibility options[/h2]
We’ve added options to adjust leniency for side and tap notes, as well as reducing or removing visual effects in levels! Any recorded scores with accessibility options used will have an indicator on the select screen.
We’ve also added a custom cursor for smoother gameplay, with adjustable display options!

[h2]More tweaks[/h2]
We’ve made several adjustments and bugfixes, including:
[list]
[*] A neat new UI displaying more level information. (You can toggle the old one back in settings!)
[*] Resprite of the inverse note for better readability
[*] New particles for side note hits
[*] Editor bugfixes and QoL changes (holds now render in the editor, yay!)
[*] Engine update from LOVE 11.5 to LOVE 12!
[*] Many, many other fixes and changes. Too many. 
[/list]

[h2]What’s after this?[/h2]
We’ll be participating in Steam’s Rhythm Fest on August 19th, so keep an eye out for that- both for Beatblock and other rhythm games! Go explore!
Beyond that, we’ll continue work on the demo and potentially showcase it at a few public events! 
You can stay updated on that via our Discord and Twitter.

Happy beatblocking! ( ^^ )=)

notes.title: Beatblock Demo- LIVE ON STEAM!
notes.content:
[h1]We’re on Steam now! [/h1]
Development’s taken a while, but we’ve got a demo out that we’ll continue to update over these coming months. But first…

[h2]What’s Beatblock?[/h2]
A headspinning rhythm game where you use your mouse to hit blocks to the beat. Different block types and mechanics will keep you on your toes as you groove to the music!

[h2]What’s in the demo?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Five levels (and counting) with both original & licensed music. 
[*] An early version of our level editor, with more additions and features planned.
[*] A custom level select to store and play other players’ charts.
[*] A built-in calibration tool for button inputs.
[*] Controller support, so you can spin whichever way you like.
[*] Cranky ( ‘ ‘ )=)
[/list]

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]
No specifics yet- but we’re cooking! At the very least, expect a few more levels and bug fixes or tweaks here and there. With a little bit of luck and a whole lotta work, we’ll have more news for you in the future! A big thank you to those who’ve already supported us on itch, and to anyone new who’s finding us for the first time! ( ^^ )=)

Find us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/mdh3XDCX5d]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/BeatblockGame]Twitter[/url] for new updates, and chat with the community!
